input.text: I was charged twice for March. Please refund the duplicate payment today, or I will cancel my subscription.

legend.0: Low: informational, routine or explicitly not time-sensitive; nothing is blocked.
legend.1: Medium: a problem needs attention soon, but there is no immediate deadline or blocked operation.
legend.2: High: an active outage, blocked work, an immediate deadline or a demand for action today.

reasons: Model confidence is below the review threshold.
The model flags an intention to cancel.
The model flags a high-urgency request.

baseline.method: Ordered keyword rules: billing, technical, sales, other. No semantic inference.

calibration: Not calibrated on these demonstration tickets.
